description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing and manipulating transfer history data stored in a local database using Room. It provides methods to query all records, filter by connection ID, get recent transfers, fetch by ID, insert, update, and delete transfer history entries.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a stream of all transfer history records ordered by start time descending.

methods.name: getByConnectionId
methods.description: Returns a stream of transfer history records for a specific connection, ordered by start time descending.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Provides a stream of recent transfer records limited by the specified count.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a transfer record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a transfer history record, returning the row ID of the inserted entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transfer history record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history record by entity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history record by its ID.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC")
androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history WHERE connectionId = :connectionId ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC")
androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM transfer_history ORDER BY startedAtMillis DESC LIMIT :limit")
